name: Breadcrumb
looksLike: trail of links showing where I am
home then category then current page
small links separated by arrows above the title
definition: A trail of parent-page links that shows where the current page sits in a site hierarchy.

notConfusedWith.difference: Shows the main destinations rather than the current page hierarchy.

prompts.short: Add a breadcrumb with linked parent pages and a marked current page.
prompts.detailed: Add a labeled breadcrumb navigation with an ordered list of parent links and aria-current on the current page. Hide separators from assistive technology, allow wrapping, and give links 44px touch targets.

html: <ol style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:8px; list-style:none; padding:0">

a11yNotes: Mark the current page with aria-current="page"
Hide separators from screen readers and let links wrap
